motivation: Instruction-following navigation without object landmarks is much harder, and standard approaches cannot be applied successfully. Large, intricate 3D mazes provide a clean test bench for learning both visual navigation and instruction understanding.
key_idea: A deep RL architecture that explicitly and jointly learns visual navigation and instruction understanding to follow landmark-free path instructions in 3D mazes.
